_comment: THE WORKFLOW MATRIX. One row per shipped workflow. A row STATES every key indicator in `key_indicators` -- the writer, its ceiling, the visual lanes, the video engine, the voices, the act shape, the device -- even where the value matches the canonical, because those are decisions and because a machine can REQUIRE one: an 8 GB card needs the small writer whatever the canonical picks, so inheriting it would follow the canonical upward into something that will not fit. Every OTHER key is omitted and inherits from the canonical workflow, which is what keeps fps, composite size and caption style out of a reader's way. Pinning is safe here because every row sits in one column of one file; the drift that once left 82 configs on a retired voice engine was invisible because it was spread over 82 files. Edit this file, run `python scripts/build_variants.py --all`, and the per-machine workflows and the generated docs are rebuilt together. The per-machine workflows are GENERATED and are never hand-edited.

rows.display_name: 8 GB NVIDIA (Ada or newer) -- video that generates its own sound, mixed under the voices: lane ltx25_foley_8gb. Single stage on 8 GB: no 2x latent upscale or refine pass, so the clip is decoded at 832x480 instead of 1664x960 (the two-stage decode, 8,080 MB measured on a 16 GB card, ran out of memory on every 8 GB leg on 2026-10-15); rtx_vsr then upscales it to the 1920x1080 canvas (it installs NVIDIA's nvidia-vfx package itself on first use). Same mix4x8 weights and prompts as the 16 GB lane, minus the upscaler file, all ungated and downloaded at queue time (no Hugging Face token). Gemma 4 E2B writer run by ComfyUI itself (comfy_native), flux3_klein stills, Kokoro voices, Stable Audio 3. THE REAL REQUIREMENT IS 8 GB VRAM **PLUS ABOUT 10 GB OF FREE SYSTEM RAM**: the 12.86 GB transformer and the 9.88 GB Gemma-4 12B text encoder stream from host RAM, and a box with 16 GB of RAM and a browser open will likely page. NOT YET PROVEN ON A LEG in this single-stage form; clip times and VRAM peaks are still to be measured.
rows.note: The 8 GB native tier: added 2026-09-23 (operator: "if it's a lane it should be in the workflows folder"), made single stage 2026-10-15 after the two-stage decode ran out of memory on every 8 GB leg. No new download beyond the 16 GB lane's files (the upscaler is not loaded). Single-stage clip times are not yet measured.

known_limits: indextts2 is NOT selectable as the announcer voice -- OTR_CastLock's announcer combo is (auto, kokoro, chatterbox, elevenlabs, google_tts, bark). It IS selectable as the character voice. Recorded here rather than worked around: the dropdown decides, the workflow runs it, and a failure gets written down.
chatterbox is an announcer-capable cloning engine but needs its own isolated venv; it is not installed on the rented pod.
OTR_ImageDirector dtype_policy accepts fp8_ok / no_fp8 / no_fp8_no_fp4 only. 'fp16' is not a choice -- it was invented here once and failed at apply time, which is the intended behaviour.

scifi_news_pro on a rented pod: the RSS bank works, and two wrong diagnoses were recorded here before the right one. It is NOT datacenter IP blocking -- with a real User-Agent, sciencedaily/BBC/MIT all return 200 from the pod and only cosmosmagazine 403s. It is NOT partial feed failure either; the fetcher already skips a refusing feed. The cause was `feedparser` missing from ComfyUI's own venv, declared in requirements.txt and pyproject.toml but installed by the provisioner into the SYSTEM python. Same root as the `accelerate` failure. Fixed in scripts/otr_pod_provision.sh.

voice_bank must match the voice engine: kokoro accepts only 'kokoro_builtin'. Setting 'default' with char_voice=kokoro raises VoiceCastingError at OTR_CastLock, 12 minutes into a leg. Found by running it, 2026-08-31.

humo is PROVEN on the RTX 5080 (32 published episodes across humo_14B_169, humo_1.7B_169, humo_1.7B and humo) and is a RunPod lab candidate elsewhere. Every node class resolves on a rented pod with no patching, and the public `humo` fetch lane now owns all five 14B files (26.7356 GiB) with pinned revisions, sizes, SHA-256 values, and atomic `.part` handling. Only the remote canonical receipt remains.

Image engine defaults: flux3_klein for every NVIDIA workflow (operator 2026-10-18; proven on the 8 GB 4060); z_image_turbo stays the shared default (AMD, and otr_canonical, which runs on any machine); sd15 remains the practical Mac image engine. flux3_klein is int8 ConvRot on every card; for z_image_turbo the weight follows the card: nvfp4 on Blackwell, bf16 on Ampere/Ada. AnimateDiff accepts no init still, so the 8 GB NVIDIA episode planner does not download or gate on an image engine for that video path.
